title: QueryTuplesResponse
description: Response returned after a successful SELECT query using the tuples format, where columns are described once and rows are arrays of values.

results.description: Array of result sets, one per statement in the request.

columns.description: Array of column descriptor objects defining the name and data type of each column in the result set.

rows.description: Array of value arrays where each inner array contains the column values for one result row in the same order as the columns array.

Column.description: Descriptor for a single column in a query result set.

name.description: Name of the column as defined in the SQL query or table schema.

dataType.description: SingleStore data type of the column (e.g., INT, VARCHAR, DATETIME).

nullable.description: When true, the column may contain NULL values.
